Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir

Class FlowlineVlpProvider

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir.FlowlineVlpProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
VlpProvider
public class FlowlineVlpProvider extends Object implements VlpProvider
Lift model of a flowline, riser or any chain of pipe segments between two network nodes, for network branch tables and for live network back-pressure calculations.

Each coordinate (surface rate, outlet pressure, water ratio, gas ratio) is recombined to a compositional stream by the VfpFluidFactory and sent through a chain of PipeBeggsAndBrills segments. The inlet pressure that delivers the requested outlet pressure is found with ForwardVlpProvider, so the value returned by bottomHolePressure(double, double, double, double, double) is the pressure at the inlet node of the branch. A failed pipe march (pressure collapsing below zero) is treated as a collapsed profile so that the inverse solve moves to a higher inlet pressure.

Version:
1.0

ESOL

    • bottomHolePressure

      public double bottomHolePressure(double rate, double outletPressure, double waterRatio, double gasRatio, double alq)
      Calculates the flowing pressure at the table datum for one table coordinate.
      Specified by:
      bottomHolePressure in interface VlpProvider
      Parameters:
      rate - surface rate in Sm3/day of the table rate basis
      outletPressure - pressure at the outlet node (THP axis value) in bara
      waterRatio - water ratio in the unit of the selected water ratio type (0 when the table has no such axis)
      gasRatio - gas ratio in the unit of the selected gas ratio type (0 when the table has no such axis)
      alq - artificial lift quantity (gas lift rate in Sm3/day, 0 when not used)
      Returns:
      flowing pressure at datum in bara; NaN or an exception marks the point as infeasible
